tests.name: ADB (USB)
tests.procedure: Settings → General → swipe left ×10 on About Device; enable App Lab; `adb devices`

tests.name: Install
tests.procedure: Install the vendor sample + ours. On `INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE` (debug key from another machine), `bringup.sh` uninstalls, reinstalls and re-provisions (C106)
tests.pass: Both in the launcher; no crash in 5 min

tests.name: Binocular
tests.procedure: `wm size`; L/R test pattern with grid and safe-area box; right-eye offset ±10 px; **circle-aspect check**; L-only and R-only glyphs
tests.pass: Size recorded; one fused image, no double vision; circle not squashed (else the stereo mode is wrong); corners visible; ≤5% janky frames at 30 fps (`gfxinfo`)

tests.name: Touch
tests.procedure: Log raw events + `TempleAction`, 20 trials per gesture; record the system "natural mode" slide direction
tests.pass: ≥19/20 each; keycodes and slide direction recorded

tests.name: PTT
tests.procedure: Hold right temple 1 s, left temple 1 s, two-finger hold; 5 min of normal wear and frame adjusting; log the raw event sequence of a triple-tap
tests.pass: Our app gets DOWN/UP (or choose toggle); **DOWN → first captured audio frame ≤100 ms**; **0** confirm-class false triggers

tests.name: Heading
tests.procedure: List sensors; N/E/S/W vs. a phone compass after figure-8 calibration; 5 min still

tests.name: Mic
tests.procedure: 10 s in each RayNeo mode and each stock source; bystander at 1 m; 20 commands. PCM streams to `selftest --serve`, which writes WAVs to `runs/bringup/<ts>/` for offline ASR scoring
tests.pass: Rate and channels as requested; wearer ≥10 dB above bystander; quiet WER ≤10% (offline)

tests.name: Camera
tests.procedure: Enumerate IDs/sizes/fps; preview 640×480 and 1280×720 for 5 min
tests.pass: ≥10 fps sustained at 720p; no session errors

tests.name: Wi-Fi
tests.procedure: TCP up/down against `selftest --serve`; 2.4 vs. 5 GHz; router and hotspot
tests.pass: ≥10 Mbit/s each way; RTT p95 <30 ms (router)

tests.name: WS soak
tests.procedure: Full app: 30 min, then kill the companion

tests.name: Inset
tests.procedure: `selftest --serve` sends 320×240 JPEG at 15 fps with `frame_id`; the glasses echo `{frame_id, recv→decoded ms}`. Latency is RTT-based, so no clocks are compared. List H.264 codecs
tests.pass: Latency p95 ≤150 ms, drops <2%, decode p95 <10 ms

tests.name: Battery
tests.procedure: 100→20% at full load (HUD + mic + inset + camera at 10 fps) and HUD-only; log every 10 s; also try while charging
tests.pass: Full load ≥30 min, HUD-only ≥60 min (targets); `CURRENT_NOW` readable

tests.name: Thermals
tests.procedure: Same runs plus thermal status, headroom, IR temperature
tests.pass: No `MODERATE` within 20 min of HUD + audio; camera onset time recorded

tests.name: Daylight
tests.procedure: In sun: brightness 50–200, fonts 16–32, swatches `fg` / `friend` / `#FFD400` / `#FF3030`; 3 viewers
tests.pass: Banner read in <1 s by 3/3; no reboot

tests.name: Inference
tests.procedure: `benchmark_model` CPU/GPU/NNAPI/QNN on YOLOX-Nano fp32/fp16/int8; record `CURRENT_NOW` sign, units and update period
tests.pass: p50/p95 ms, mJ/inference, thermal status, `CURRENT_NOW` semantics recorded
